properties.comment: Group trees: subtrees, parent lines, acceptance agreements, nearest attributes
properties.entry: WITH RECURSIVE tree (id, lvl) AS ( SELECT g.ID, 1 FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :groupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID, t.lvl + 1 FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ) SELECT id FROM tree ORDER BY lvl, id

WITH RECURSIVE parent_line (id, parent_id, lvl) AS ( SELECT g.ID, g.PARENT_ID, 1 FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :groupId UNION ALL SELECT p.ID, p.PARENT_ID, pl.lvl + 1 FROM TBL_GROUP p JOIN parent_line pl ON p.ID = pl.parent_id ) SELECT id FROM parent_line ORDER BY lvl

WITH RECURSIVE parent_line (id, parent_id, lvl) AS ( SELECT g.ID, g.PARENT_ID, 1 FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :groupId UNION ALL SELECT p.ID, p.PARENT_ID, pl.lvl + 1 FROM TBL_GROUP p JOIN parent_line pl ON p.ID = pl.parent_id ), agreement_owner (id) AS ( SELECT pl.id FROM parent_line pl WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM GROUP_ASSOCIATEDGROUP ga JOIN TBL_GROUP target ON target.ID = ga.ASSOCIATEDGROUP_ID AND target.TYPENAME = :targetType WHERE ga.GROUP_ID = pl.id) ORDER BY pl.lvl LIMIT 1 ), accepted_subtree (id) AS ( SELECT ga.ASSOCIATEDGROUP_ID FROM GROUP_ASSOCIATEDGROUP ga JOIN agreement_owner ao ON ga.GROUP_ID = ao.id JOIN TBL_GROUP target ON target.ID = ga.ASSOCIATEDGROUP_ID AND target.TYPENAME = :targetType UNION SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN accepted_subtree s ON c.PARENT_ID = s.id ) SELECT id FROM accepted_subtree ORDER BY id

WITH RECURSIVE source_line (source_id, id, parent_id, lvl) AS ( SELECT g.ID, g.ID, g.PARENT_ID, 1 FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.TYPENAME = :sourceType UNION ALL SELECT sl.source_id, p.ID, p.PARENT_ID, sl.lvl + 1 FROM TBL_GROUP p JOIN source_line sl ON p.ID = sl.parent_id ), agreement_owner (source_id, owner_id) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (sl.source_id) sl.source_id, sl.id FROM source_line sl WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM GROUP_ASSOCIATEDGROUP ga JOIN TBL_GROUP target ON target.ID = ga.ASSOCIATEDGROUP_ID AND target.TYPENAME = :targetType WHERE ga.GROUP_ID = sl.id) ORDER BY sl.source_id, sl.lvl ), target_line (id, parent_id) AS ( SELECT g.ID, g.PARENT_ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :groupId UNION ALL SELECT p.ID, p.PARENT_ID FROM TBL_GROUP p JOIN target_line tl ON p.ID = tl.parent_id ) SELECT DISTINCT ao.source_id FROM agreement_owner ao JOIN GROUP_ASSOCIATEDGROUP ga ON ga.GROUP_ID = ao.owner_id JOIN target_line tl ON tl.id = ga.ASSOCIATEDGROUP_ID JOIN TBL_GROUP target ON target.ID = ga.ASSOCIATEDGROUP_ID AND target.TYPENAME = :targetType ORDER BY ao.source_id

WITH RECURSIVE parent_line (id, parent_id, lvl) AS ( SELECT g.ID, g.PARENT_ID, 1 FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :groupId UNION ALL SELECT p.ID, p.PARENT_ID, pl.lvl + 1 FROM TBL_GROUP p JOIN parent_line pl ON p.ID = pl.parent_id ) SELECT a.ID FROM parent_line pl JOIN GRP_ATTR_SITE_TENANT a ON a.GROUP_ID = pl.id ORDER BY pl.lvl LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE parent_line (id, parent_id, lvl) AS ( SELECT g.ID, g.PARENT_ID, 1 FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :groupId UNION ALL SELECT p.ID, p.PARENT_ID, pl.lvl + 1 FROM TBL_GROUP p JOIN parent_line pl ON p.ID = pl.parent_id ) SELECT a.ID FROM parent_line pl JOIN GRP_ATTR_ISSUER_TENANT a ON a.GROUP_ID = pl.id ORDER BY pl.lvl LIMIT 1

SELECT p.ID FROM PEDESTAL p INNER JOIN (WITH RECURSIVE tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :userSiteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id) SELECT id FROM tree) su ON p.GROUP_ID = su.id WHERE p.CODE = :pedestalCode

WITH RECURSIVE user_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :userSiteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN user_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ), parent_line (id, parent_id, lvl) AS ( SELECT g.ID, g.PARENT_ID, 1 FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :guestIssuerGroupId UNION ALL SELECT p.ID, p.PARENT_ID, pl.lvl + 1 FROM TBL_GROUP p JOIN parent_line pl ON p.ID = pl.parent_id ), agreement_owner (id) AS ( SELECT pl.id FROM parent_line pl WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM GROUP_ASSOCIATEDGROUP ga JOIN TBL_GROUP target ON target.ID = ga.ASSOCIATEDGROUP_ID AND target.TYPENAME = 'SITE' WHERE ga.GROUP_ID = pl.id) ORDER BY pl.lvl LIMIT 1 ), accepted_subtree (id) AS ( SELECT ga.ASSOCIATEDGROUP_ID FROM GROUP_ASSOCIATEDGROUP ga JOIN agreement_owner ao ON ga.GROUP_ID = ao.id JOIN TBL_GROUP target ON target.ID = ga.ASSOCIATEDGROUP_ID AND target.TYPENAME = 'SITE' UNION SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN accepted_subtree s ON c.PARENT_ID = s.id ) SELECT p.ID FROM PEDESTAL p WHERE p.DELETED = FALSE AND p.GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM user_tree) AND p.GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM accepted_subtree) ORDER BY p.CODE

WITH RECURSIVE tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :userSiteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ) SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.CODE FROM PEDESTAL p JOIN tree t ON p.GROUP_ID = t.id WHERE p.DELETED = FALSE

SELECT c.ID FROM CAMPING_CARD c JOIN GUEST g ON g.ID = c.GUEST_ID WHERE c.DELETED = FALSE AND c.STATUS = 'ACTIVATED' AND g.DELETED = FALSE AND g.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (c.VALID_FROM IS NULL OR c.VALID_FROM <= :day) AND (c.VALID_TO IS NULL OR c.VALID_TO >= :day) AND c.BILLING_ACCOUNT_NO IS NOT NULL AND g.GROUP_ID IN (:issuerGroupIds) ORDER BY c.ID DESC

WITH RECURSIVE site_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :siteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN site_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ), issuer_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :issuerGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN issuer_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ) SELECT v.ID FROM ( SELECT cr.ID, cr.PLUG_OUT FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_OUT >= :from AND cr.PLUG_OUT <= :to AND cr.SITE_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM site_tree) UNION SELECT cr.ID, cr.PLUG_OUT FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_OUT >= :from AND cr.PLUG_OUT <= :to AND cr.ISSUER_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM issuer_tree) ) v ORDER BY v.PLUG_OUT DESC, v.ID DESC

WITH RECURSIVE site_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :siteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN site_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ), issuer_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :issuerGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN issuer_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ) SELECT v.ID FROM ( SELECT cr.ID, cr.PLUG_OUT FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_OUT >= :from AND cr.PLUG_OUT <= :to AND cr.SITE_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM site_tree) AND (CAST(:validationState AS VARCHAR) IS NULL OR cr.VALIDATION_STATE = :validationState) UNION SELECT cr.ID, cr.PLUG_OUT FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_OUT >= :from AND cr.PLUG_OUT <= :to AND cr.ISSUER_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM issuer_tree) AND (CAST(:validationState AS VARCHAR) IS NULL OR cr.VALIDATION_STATE = :validationState) ) v ORDER BY v.PLUG_OUT DESC, v.ID DESC LIMIT :pageSize OFFSET :offset

WITH RECURSIVE site_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :siteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN site_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ), issuer_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :issuerGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN issuer_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ) SELECT v.ID FROM ( SELECT cr.ID, cr.PLUG_OUT FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_OUT >= :from AND cr.PLUG_OUT <= :to AND cr.SITE_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM site_tree) AND cr.EXPORT_STATUS = 'NEW' UNION SELECT cr.ID, cr.PLUG_OUT FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_OUT >= :from AND cr.PLUG_OUT <= :to AND cr.ISSUER_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM issuer_tree) AND cr.EXPORT_STATUS = 'NEW' ) v ORDER BY v.PLUG_OUT, v.ID

WITH RECURSIVE site_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :siteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN site_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ), issuer_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :issuerGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN issuer_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ) SELECT cr.SOCKET_CODE, cr.PEDESTAL_CODE, cr.PLUG_IN, cr.PLUG_OUT, cr.KWH FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_OUT >= :from AND cr.PLUG_OUT <= :to AND cr.PLUG_IN IS NOT NULL AND cr.KWH IS NOT NULL AND cr.VALIDATION_STATE <> 'REJECTED' AND (cr.SITE_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM site_tree) OR cr.ISSUER_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM issuer_tree)) AND (CAST(:powerSectionId AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR cr.SOCKET_ID IN (SELECT s.ID FROM SOCKET s WHERE s.POWER_SECTION_ID = :powerSectionId)) ORDER BY cr.PLUG_IN, cr.ID

WITH RECURSIVE site_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :siteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN site_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ), issuer_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :issuerGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN issuer_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ) SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) || '_' || TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cr.PLUG_OUT), 'FM00') AS TIME_PERIOD, SUM(cr.KWH) AS KWH, COUNT(cr.ID) AS RECORDS, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cr.PLUG_OUT - cr.PLUG_IN))) / 3600 AS HOURS FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_IN IS NOT NULL AND cr.KWH IS NOT NULL AND cr.VALIDATION_STATE <> 'REJECTED' AND (cr.SITE_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM site_tree) OR cr.ISSUER_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM issuer_tree)) AND (CAST(:powerSectionId AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR cr.SOCKET_ID IN (SELECT s.ID FROM SOCKET s WHERE s.POWER_SECTION_ID = :powerSectionId)) AND (CAST(:year AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) = :year) AND (CAST(:month AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) = :month) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) || '_' || TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cr.PLUG_OUT), 'FM00') ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) || '_' || TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cr.PLUG_OUT), 'FM00') ASC

WITH RECURSIVE site_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :siteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN site_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ), issuer_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :issuerGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN issuer_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ) SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) || '_Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) AS TIME_PERIOD, SUM(cr.KWH) AS KWH, COUNT(cr.ID) AS RECORDS, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cr.PLUG_OUT - cr.PLUG_IN))) / 3600 AS HOURS FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_IN IS NOT NULL AND cr.KWH IS NOT NULL AND cr.VALIDATION_STATE <> 'REJECTED' AND (cr.SITE_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM site_tree) OR cr.ISSUER_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM issuer_tree)) AND (CAST(:powerSectionId AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR cr.SOCKET_ID IN (SELECT s.ID FROM SOCKET s WHERE s.POWER_SECTION_ID = :powerSectionId)) AND (CAST(:year AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) = :year) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) || '_Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) || '_Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM cr.PLUG_OUT) ASC

WITH RECURSIVE site_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :siteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN site_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ), issuer_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :issuerGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN issuer_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ) SELECT COALESCE(cr.CAMPSITE_CODE, 'N/A') AS CAMPSITE_CODE, SUM(cr.KWH) AS KWH, SUM(cr.NIGHTS) AS NIGHTS FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_OUT >= :from AND cr.PLUG_OUT <= :to AND cr.KWH IS NOT NULL AND cr.NIGHTS > 0 AND cr.VALIDATION_STATE <> 'REJECTED' AND (cr.SITE_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM site_tree) OR cr.ISSUER_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM issuer_tree)) AND (CAST(:powerSectionId AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR cr.SOCKET_ID IN (SELECT s.ID FROM SOCKET s WHERE s.POWER_SECTION_ID = :powerSectionId)) GROUP BY COALESCE(cr.CAMPSITE_CODE, 'N/A') ORDER BY COALESCE(cr.CAMPSITE_CODE, 'N/A')

WITH RECURSIVE site_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :siteGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN site_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ), issuer_tree (id) AS ( SELECT g.ID FROM TBL_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :issuerGroupId UNION ALL SELECT c.ID FROM TBL_GROUP c JOIN issuer_tree t ON c.PARENT_ID = t.id ) SELECT cr.PEDESTAL_CODE, SUM(cr.KWH) AS KWH, COUNT(cr.ID) AS RECORDS FROM CONSUMPTION_RECORD cr WHERE cr.PLUG_OUT >= :from AND cr.PLUG_OUT < :to AND cr.KWH IS NOT NULL AND cr.VALIDATION_STATE <> 'REJECTED' AND cr.PEDESTAL_CODE IN (:pedestalCodes) AND (cr.SITE_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM site_tree) OR cr.ISSUER_GROUP_ID IN (SELECT id FROM issuer_tree)) GROUP BY cr.PEDESTAL_CODE
